entities.name: UserCompanyAgent
entities.rationale: Independent insurance agents accessing the application.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: CloudFront serves the single page application (SPA) frontend to the agents.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: S3 bucket storing the static SPA web assets.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: API Gateway acts as the entry point for backend API calls.

entities.name: Lambda Authorizer
entities.rationale: Lambda function executing custom authorization logic to validate tokens.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Serverless Python Lambda executing core business logic and modernized functions.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: EC2 instances hosting legacy Tomcat Java application functions that haven't been migrated yet.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: DynamoDB regional table used to cache user session data across availability zones.

visual_connections.description: Agents request and access the frontend single page application.
CloudFront retrieves static assets from the S3 bucket.
API requests from the application frontend are routed to API Gateway.
API Gateway triggers the Lambda Authorizer to validate user access permissions.
Authorized calls are routed to the main Python backend Lambda.
Main Lambda calls the legacy Tomcat application running on EC2 for unmigrated features.
Legacy Tomcat application returns data back to the serverless backend.
Main Lambda caches and retrieves regional user session information in DynamoDB.
